description: Unpublished behavioral tasks for blind agent patch generation. Agent descriptors exclude this manifest's test commands and all evaluator fields.

tasks.description: Update _escape_inner so a backtick is escaped as ` while preserving all existing HTML escaping behavior.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from markupsafe._native import _escape_inner; assert _escape_inner('`<&') == '`<&'; assert _escape_inner('\"') == '"'"

tasks.description: Make canonicalize_name ignore leading and trailing whitespace before validation and normalization, without changing normal inputs.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from packaging.utils import canonicalize_name; assert canonicalize_name('  Django.Plugin ') == 'django-plugin'; assert canonicalize_name(' requests ', validate=True) == 'requests'"

tasks.description: Make canonicalize_version ignore surrounding whitespace on string versions before parsing while preserving existing canonicalization options.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from packaging.utils import canonicalize_version; assert canonicalize_version(' 1.0.0 ') == '1'; assert canonicalize_version(' 1.0.0 ', strip_trailing_zero=False) == '1.0.0'; assert canonicalize_version('  invalid version  ') == 'invalid version'"

tasks.description: Extend to_native_string to accept memoryview values and decode their bytes with the requested encoding while preserving str and bytes behavior.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from requests._internal_utils import to_native_string; assert to_native_string(memoryview(b'caf\xc3\xa9'), 'utf-8') == 'caf\u00e9'; assert to_native_string('ready') == 'ready'"

tasks.description: Change unicode_is_ascii to return False for non-string values instead of raising, while retaining correct ASCII and Unicode results.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from requests._internal_utils import unicode_is_ascii; assert unicode_is_ascii('plain'); assert not unicode_is_ascii('caf\u00e9'); assert unicode_is_ascii(42) is False"

tasks.description: Allow escapeStringRegexp to accept boxed String objects as well as primitive strings, while continuing to reject unrelated values.
tasks.test_command: node --input-type=module -e "import escape from './index.js'; if (escape(new String('a-b')) !== 'a\\x2db') process.exit(1); let rejected = false; try { escape(42); } catch (error) { rejected = error instanceof TypeError; } if (!rejected) process.exit(2)"

tasks.description: Change Queue.dequeue so an empty queue returns null instead of undefined, while preserving FIFO behavior and size tracking.
tasks.test_command: node --input-type=module -e "import Queue from './index.js'; const queue = new Queue(); if (queue.dequeue() !== null) process.exit(1); queue.enqueue('a'); queue.enqueue('b'); if (queue.dequeue() !== 'a' || queue.size !== 1) process.exit(2)"

tasks.description: Make Queue.clear return the number of items removed while still resetting head, tail, and size correctly.
tasks.test_command: node --input-type=module -e "import Queue from './index.js'; const queue = new Queue(); queue.enqueue(1); queue.enqueue(2); if (queue.clear() !== 2 || queue.size !== 0 || queue.peek() !== undefined) process.exit(1); if (queue.clear() !== 0) process.exit(2)"
